patthana17.9:1.1: Kusalaṃ ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo naācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana17.9:2.1: Kusalaṃ apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo naapacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.9:3.1: Abyākataṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naabyākato nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
